描述_EN: the roundels are placed so that, when the material is cut and sewn to make a robe or jacket, the design is evenly spaced and sits well on the back and front of the finished garment. this light yellow silk has subdued twill roundels woven along its length. this type of roundel pattern lends itself to east asian straight-seamed tailoring - not the only dressmaking tradition in that region but a very popular one.
描述_ZN: 圆点的位置是这样的，当材料被切割和缝制成长袍或夹克时，设计是均匀间隔的，并且很好地坐落在成品服装的背面和正面。 这种浅黄色的丝绸沿其长度方向织有低调的斜纹圆点。 这种圆形图案适合东亚的直缝裁缝--这不是该地区唯一的制衣传统，但却是非常流行的一种。
